'''Locust riders''' are encountered during the [[Contact!]] quest, inside the [[Sophanem Dungeon]] maze. The green versions attack using somewhat slow [[Ranged]] attacks. The brown versions however, are much more dangerous and attack with accurate [[melee]] attacks that can hit for over 700 damage. Remember that you need to bring a [[light source]] when you are in the dungeon.

Locust riders are scattered mercifully thin throughout the dungeon. If a player takes the right path, it's doubtful they will even encounter one. Still, should a player encounter them, they should remember that they commonly hit over 300, so [[Prayer#Prayers|Protection Prayers]] and good food are of the utmost importance, especially if multiple riders are encountered.

The [[Keris]] dagger special effect works against locust riders.

Though not directly assigned, locust riders may be slain as part of a [[Scabarites (Slayer assignment)|Scabarite]] assignment. These monsters respawn at an extremely fast rate, so it may be ideal to stay in one spot.
